description:
ABOUT THE ROLE

Join a well-funded AI and robotics startup tackling some of the hardest open problems in the field. This is a senior individual contributor role for engineers who are obsessed with novel, technically difficult challenges — the kind that don't have existing solutions. You'll work across systems-level infrastructure, real-time AI state management, custom OS development, and UX grounded in human psychology and organisational behaviour.


WHAT YOU'LL DO

 - Design and build custom database and memory systems from scratch.

 - Implement real-time LLM token state management at large scale.

 - Develop custom Unix OS distributions tailored for both humans and AI agents.

 - Rethink UX paradigms using insights from organisational behaviour and human psychology.

 - Pursue compounding micro-optimisations across the full stack.

 - Work onsite 5 days a week in San Francisco.


WHAT WE'RE LOOKING FOR

 - Required: Deep obsession with novel, overlooked, or technically unsolved problems.

 - Required: Demonstrated ability to build large, complex, and maintainable systems in roughly one-third the time most engineers consider possible.

 - Required: Proficiency in one or more of: TypeScript, Rust, Python.

 - Required: Experience with graph databases, flexible data pipelines, or ontological modelling.

 - Comfort applying psychology and organisational behaviour insights to product and UX decisions.

 - Signal of outlier intelligence — top academic background or standout real-world experience (non-traditional backgrounds welcome).


COMPENSATION & BENEFITS

 - Cash compensation: $200,000 – $400,000 USD annually

 - Variable equity on top of cash

 - Visa sponsorship available


LOCATION

On-site in San Francisco, CA (South Park neighbourhood). This is a fully in-person role — remote work is not available.
